open.one.beat: A ship brings a torn page to the first island, where a single open vowel says its name.

open.vcv.beat: A robot at a local hotel on the path shows a two-part word that splits after the open first vowel.

open.y.beat: A y at the end of a word sings a long e sound, and a baby bunny is the example.

open.flex.beat: A split that looks right does not fit the sound, so the apprentice flips it and the word clicks.
